hana: Quick flag from an onboarding smoke for aurora-proto (quant=q4c). We ran the multilang translate smoke and found mirrored punctuation & stray bracket swaps in zh-Hant and he-IL outputs. Dropping a tiny repro and token dumps.

diego: paste the eval command + one minimal failing sample?

hana: eval cmd: `./ci/onboard_eval --model aurora-proto --quant q4c --suite multilang:translate_smoke --locales zh-Hant,he-IL,ar-EG --out /tmp/aurora_q4c_smoke.jsonl`

hana: sample zh-Hant:
- src: "\u65e5\u671f: 8/14 (\u9031\u4e8c)"
- ref: "Date: 8/14 (Tue)"
- aurora-q4c: "Date: 8/14 \uff09Tue\uff08"  <-- mirrored parentheses, order odd

irene: sample he-IL?

hana: he sample:
- src: "(\u05e9\u05de\u05d5\u05e0) 09/01"
- ref: "(Name) 09/01"
- aurora-q4c: "(\u05e9\u05de\u05d5\u05e0] 09/01"  <-- closing brace changed to ']' 

diego: can we see tokenizer tokens pre-infer and the detok output? Need to know if token stream diverges.

hana: quick dumps:
```
# pre-infer tokens: ["(","\u05e9\u05de\u05d5\u05e0",")"," ","09","/","01"]
# detok output (aurora-q4c): ["(","\u05e9\u05de\u05d5\u05e0","]"," ","09","/","01"]
```

hana: pre-detok streams are IDENTICAL to our q8 baseline for the same samples. So root cause is detok/postprocessing.

L10n-bot: /report locale_regression model=aurora-proto quant=q4c suite=multilang:translate_smoke delta_bleu_zhTW=-0.19 delta_bleu_he=-0.55 samples=420

diego: any recent build metadata? Which kernel pack picked up the q4c variant?

Build-bot: /build meta model=aurora-proto variant=q4c kernel=kernel_pack_2026-06-11-5f7b ICU_DETOK=true
diriego: (typo) I mean diego: ICU_DETOK=true in that pack could explain differences. We recently landed an ICU fallback that applies bidi/mirroring at detok time. If our mirror table also runs, it double-applies.

irene: hypothesis matches. Repro locally by calling detok binary with and without ICU flag: `./bin/detok --use-icu "(\u05e9\u05de\u05d5\u05e0)"` -> returns bracket-swapped output. `--no-icu` returns correct.

diego: mitigation: create a routing override for affected locales to q8 until we ship a hotfix. Console snippet we applied: `{"routing":{"locale_overrides":{"zh-Hant":"aurora-proto-q8","he-IL":"aurora-proto-q8","ar-EG":"aurora-proto-q8"}}}`

hana: filed ticket ML-ONBOARD-801 with sample set, tokenizer dumps, detok diffs, and kernel pack diff. Attaching bisect notes.

diego: plan: bisect kernel_pack changes around ICU_DETOK integration (commit range c21a -> d34f). If ICU path is desired long-term, we need to harmonize mirror handling (disable in-house mirror table when ICU_DETOK=true). Low-risk hotfix: rebuild q4c packs with ICU_DETOK=false.

irene: I'll try a local patch that sets DETOK_MIRROR_MODE=canonical and run the smoke. If quick fix works, we can hotfix pack and run full smoke.

L10n-bot: Label added: priority=P2 impact=translation-quality

diego: also adding a unit test covering mixed-script punctuation adjacency (ascii weekday next to RTL/Han punctuation) to prevent regressions.

hana: thanks all. I'll keep artifacts in ML-ONBOARD-801 and update when hotfix PR lands. If anyone sees similar anomalies in other locales, ping this thread. :mag:
